title: OneDrive and SharePoint: annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the web viewer
summary: Hold: changing a label's encryption permissions does not update every file carrying that label as the briefing claims. Microsoft qualifies updates by the encryption configuration and reauthentication; the roadmap facts and existing PDF support control are supported.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The PDF support control is reached in Microsoft Purview portal through Solutions > Information Protection > Sensitivity labels > Policies > Auto-labeling policies > Protect PDFs with Auto-labeling.
claims.quote:
Solutions > Information Protection > Sensitivity labels > Policies > Auto-labeling policies
Then, if you see a message Protect PDFs with Auto-labeling, select this banner to confirm you want to turn on PDF protection for files in SharePoint and OneDrive.

The valid values are:
True - Enables support for PDFs.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Solutions > Information Protection > Sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview portal is the route printed for configuring label encryption rights.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Information Protection > Sensitivity labels
To edit an existing label, select it, and then select the Edit label icon.
claims.fix: The path stops on the correct labels page. Extend it to 'Solutions > Information Protection > Sensitivity labels > label > Edit label > Choose protection settings for the types of items you selected > Control access > Access control > Configure access control settings > Assign permissions now > Assign permissions > Choose permissions'. The label must include Files & other data assets. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/encryption-sensitivity-labels alongside the existing creation page.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Set-Label -Identity <MasterIdParameter> -EncryptionRightsDefinitions <EncryptionRightsDefinitionsParameter> modifies a label's defined encryption rights.
claims.quote: The EncryptionRightsDefinitions parameter specifies the rights users have when accessing protected. This parameter uses the syntax Identity1:Rights1,Rights2;Identity2:Rights3,Rights4.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls table

claims.quote:
When you select Configure access control settings on the Access control page to create or edit a sensitivity label, choose one of the following options:
Assign permissions now

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Label encryption settings govern access to protected content.
claims.quote: Can be decrypted only by users authorized by the label's encryption settings.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: A label's assigned encryption permissions determine which users hold which usage rights on protected content.
claims.quote: Assign permissions now, so that you determine exactly which users get which permissions to content with that label.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Edit Content, Edit is a documented usage right distinct from Save.
claims.quote:
Common name: Edit Content, Edit Encoding in policy: DOCEDIT
Allows the user to modify, rearrange, format, or sort the content inside the application, which includes Office on the web. It doesn't grant the right to save the edited copy.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Save is a separately documented usage right.
claims.quote:
Common name: Save Encoding in policy: EDIT
Allows the user to save the item to the current location. In Office on the web, it also allows the user to edit the content.

claims.where: Governance controls: final sentence
claims.claim: Changes to encryption permissions on a label apply to every file carrying that label.
claims.quote: However, if users have already opened an encrypted document or email, they won't get the new settings until their use license has expired and they must reauthenticate.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence with: 'For labels configured with Assign permissions now, changes to users or permissions apply to existing encrypted items when users authenticate with the encryption service; users with an existing use licence receive the changes when it expires and they reauthenticate, so test before editing a label in use.' This qualification is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/encryption-sensitivity-labels#editing-labels-to-newly-apply-encryption-or-change-existing-encryption-settings.
